landing.aboutUsText: We are a local website design studio in Ayase, Kanagawa, Japan. We provide online presence ranging anywhere from simple WordPress websites to complex, scalable applications. Whatever your goal, we are sure we can meet your needs. Have a look at some of our past projects here and see the many ways in which our services can turn your digital dream into a reality.
landing.aboutUsSubtext1: Translations are done by a Japanese translator and checked by an American, native-level English speaker with a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (BSBA). We promise high-quality, business-level Japanese to English translation, so you can rest assured that even native-level English speakers will find your content to flow and sound natural. We also provide translation for documents of all types, and transcription of audio and video data.
landing.aboutUsSubtext2: Want to get a website, but do not know how? Advertise and sell to customers outside of Japan? Own a website you can alter yourself easily? Do all this for a low budget? Please consult us and we can assist you with all of these. Feel free to ask questions and we will support you according to our ethics of kindness, politeness, and speed. We also support standalone english websites and pages.
